title: static-site-hls player config
description: Settings written into <data-dir>/static-site-hls.js (the `/*CONFIG*/ {…}` literal) and from there inlined into every built page that plays HLS. Not migrated: the player file is regenerated from the index settings on every convert, and pages are rebuilt when it changes.

dataDir.description: --data-dir, relative to the site root. With videosDir, lets the player find a playlist's site root, and hls.min.js from there.

posters.description: Whether the player sets each playlist's poster.jpg as the video's poster.
